adjudication.rationale: In `admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6`, `saveChanges()` calls `this.get('embedding').update({})` without handling the returned promise (no `.then/.catch`), so it is effectively fire-and-forget. On the server, `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` is indeed a no-op that only re-renders the serialized embedding and performs no persistence. However, the provided `embedding.hbs` template does not wire up any UI action to `saveChanges` (it only has `addHost` and per-host save/delete), so the diff does not prove a user-visible broken “save” behavior—more an unused/incomplete action/endpoint than a verifiable defect.
